instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet. For choux pastry, boil water, milk, butter, salt, and sugar, add flour, stir until smooth, then beat in eggs. Pipe 10 cm strips onto sheet, bake 10 mins at 200°C, reduce to 180°C, and bake 20-25 mins more; cool. For pastry cream, heat milk until simmering, whisk sugar, yolks, and cornstarch, add hot milk, then cook until thick; stir in vanilla and butter, cool, then pipe into éclairs. For glaze, melt chocolate and cream, dip tops of éclairs, and let set before serving.

Preheat oven to 160°C and grease a 23 cm springform pan. Mix crust ingredients, press into pan, and set aside. For filling, beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth, add vanilla and eggs one at a time, then fold in sour cream and heavy cream. Pour filling over crust and bake for 55-70 minutes until almost set. Turn off oven, crack door, and let cool for 1 hour. Chill at least 4 hours before serving.

Preheat oven to 180°C, line a 20 cm square pan. Melt chocolate and butter, mix in sugar, eggs, and vanilla. Fold in flour, cocoa, and salt. Pour into pan and bake 25-30 minutes. Cool, then cut and serve.
Mix the ingreients. Let it rest, then bake for 25 minutes at 200C.
